recent_posts.title: Let’s build a Podcast app for Fire TV using Vega OS & React Native
recent_posts.summary: A full walkthrough for building and publishing a podcast app for Amazon Fire TV using Vega OS and React Native. Covers setting up VGA developer tools via an MCP-based installer, scaffolding a cross-platform monorepo targeting Vega OS, Android TV, Apple TV, and web from a shared codebase, building multiple screens (home, podcast details, audio player, search) with real data from the Podcast Index API, and submitting the final release build to the Amazon App Store. The tutorial uses Claude Code with the Amazon Builder Tools MCP to accelerate development and demonstrates TV-specific patterns like focus/blur state management for remote-control navigation.

recent_posts.title: State of React Native - What's new in 2026
recent_posts.summary: A walkthrough of the 2025 State of React Native survey results, covering developer demographics, platform targets, popular libraries for navigation (Expo Router dominating at 71%), styling (NativeWind growing to 42%), animations (React Native Reanimated at 93%), testing tools, analytics, build tooling (EAS Build leading), and AI code generation trends. Key findings include 80% adoption of the new architecture, 86% of developers on macOS, Expo CLI used by ~90% of respondents, and growing AI-assisted development workflows.

recent_posts.title: Mobile app onboarding and paywall strategies for indie developers
recent_posts.summary: A podcast conversation between a developer and a mobile app growth consultant covering strategies for effective onboarding flows and paywall design. Key topics include: reducing friction by delaying or skipping account creation, using anonymous/guest users, segmenting onboarding for new vs. returning users, minimizing unnecessary clicks, leveraging app-open events for personalized experiences, and the psychology behind paywall copy and design. The discussion also includes a live critique of a headshot AI app's onboarding and App Store presence, with specific advice on icon A/B testing, notification permission timing, camera permission UX, and paywall layout improvements such as showing the user's generated photo to increase conversion.

recent_posts.title: State of Subscription Apps - What's working in 2026
recent_posts.summary: A walkthrough of RevenueCat's 2026 State of Subscription Apps report, covering key data points for indie mobile developers. Key findings include: hard paywalls convert 5x better than premium models; longer trials (17+ days) convert 70% better than short ones despite the market trending toward 3-day trials; apps launched before 2020 still generate 69% of all subscription revenue; AI-powered apps earn 41% more revenue per payer but churn 30% faster; annual plans generate 2x higher revenue per install vs monthly; higher-priced apps convert downloads to trials at nearly 2x the rate of lower-priced apps; and 41% of top-performing apps have web revenue streams. Benchmark data is provided for MRR growth, LTV, conversion rates, and pricing by category and geography.

recent_posts.title: Lessons learned after Apple banned my AI girlfriend app
recent_posts.summary: An indie developer shares the story of having their AI girlfriend app removed from the App Store after it grew to represent 90% of downloads and 75% of revenue across a 12-app portfolio. The ban came under Apple's 1.1 safety/objectionable content guideline despite the app using safe pre-generated images and Anthropic's guarded models. Key lessons include: avoid over-reliance on a single app, treat every app as a transferable learning experiment, and strictly follow platform rules especially in sensitive categories. The developer views the ban as a mixed outcome — painful financially but a relief given personal discomfort with the app's concept.

recent_posts.title: Expo SDK 55 in practice - Upgrading & Testing new Features
recent_posts.summary: A hands-on walkthrough of Expo SDK 55, covering new features including React Native 0.83 and React 19.2 integration, Hermes V1 JavaScript engine with opt-in support, Hermes bytecode diffing for EAS updates (75% reduction in download size), the new Colors API for dynamic system colors, Apple Zoom shared element transitions, iOS Stack Toolbar, Expo UI native components, and the alpha release of Expo Widgets for iOS home screen widgets and live activities. Also covers the new package versioning convention (all Expo packages now start with 55), the move to a src/ folder in Expo Router, dropping legacy architecture support, and Expo MCP server improvements with agent skills for AI-assisted development.

recent_posts.title: How decoy pricing works for subscription apps
recent_posts.summary: A brief discussion of the 'decoy pricing' strategy for subscription apps, where one plan is priced outrageously high to make other plans feel like a better deal. The speaker shares a real example using a $350 lifetime plan alongside a $9.99/month subscription to nudge users toward the preferred pricing tier.

recent_posts.title: Why is onboarding flow so Important?
recent_posts.summary: Onboarding flow is as critical as paywalls for app profitability. Focusing solely on paywalls yields minor results, but combining a strong onboarding flow with an optimized paywall dramatically improves conversion numbers. The lesson came from firsthand experience with a social media growth app where poor onboarding hurt unit economics despite acquisition efforts.

recent_posts.title: What's the goal of the Onboarding flow?
recent_posts.summary: Onboarding flows serve dual purposes: helping users understand an app's value proposition and driving developer revenue. A well-designed onboarding communicates benefits, positioning, and features clearly enough that users self-select and convert to paid plans or free trials.

recent_posts.title: Mobile app onboarding best practices for higher conversions
recent_posts.summary: A podcast conversation with Alex, co-founder of Screens Design, covering mobile app onboarding best practices. Key topics include: why onboarding and paywalls are inseparable for profitability, key metrics to track (open-to-trial rate, trial-to-paid conversion), A/B testing methodology using Mixpanel and Remote Config, psychological principles like friction reduction, personalization, and social proof, optimal onboarding length by app niche, and a live demo of Screens Design's AI-powered onboarding screen generator that exports HTML for use with Claude Code or React Native.
